rationale: Not a tactics probe — a data one, and the cheapest possible guard on WS-A. If a refactor stops emitting movement records the AI keeps playing and every offline analysis silently starts describing a smaller game. Nine units move; at least six must produce a movement decision record with two or more scored candidates.

assert.name: at least 6 movement records carry >= 2 scored candidates
every movement candidate's terms sum to its score
script: # A2: a candidate's score_breakdown holds the additive terms (they sum to
# the score) AND per-candidate descriptors that are not addends: distance,
# gap to close, turns to reach, VP at stake, Advance odds, the assigning pass.
# AIReasoningGlossary.is_addend is the one place that says which is which -
# the K breakdown panel prints its ledger with it - so a descriptor registered
# there is skipped here, and one that is not fails here exactly as it would
# show up in the panel as a score term. (The hard-coded SKIP list this used
# went red when 03ed34d added gap_inches and adv_chance.)
if v is float or v is int:
